title: Coin change II (count ways)
statement: Count the combinations of coins (unlimited supply) that sum to amount. Order doesn't matter: 1 + 2 and 2 + 1 are the same. Answers fit in 64 bits.
hints: Loop over coins on the outside and amounts on the inside.
Swapping the loops counts ordered sequences (permutations) instead.

solution.explanation: Loop order is the state definition. Coins outside: after processing coin c, dp[a] counts combinations using only the first coins, so each multiset is built in one canonical order. Amounts outside: dp[a] sums over the last coin, counting sequences. Say which one the question wants before coding; this is the most frequently confused pair in DP.
